title: Gotrade Daily: Micron Beats, ISM Data Tests the Market
summary: Micron beat estimates and raised its outlook. Tonight, US jobless claims and ISM Manufacturing data land. Watchlist: MU, NVDA, TSM, PSKY.
body_markdown:
### Jobless claims and ISM Manufacturing


Weekly initial jobless claims come out at 8:30 a.m. ET from the[US Department of Labor](https://www.dol.gov/ui/data.pdf) . According to[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/jobless-claims-manufacturing-pmi-and-ism-data-due-thursday-93CH-4925705) , claims are expected at 201,000, up from 197,000 last week. Then at 10:00 a.m. ET,[ISM](https://www.ismworld.org/supply-management-news-and-reports/reports/ism-report-on-business/) releases its September Manufacturing PMI, forecast at 54.8 from 54.6. It is the last major reading before Friday's jobs report.


### Paramount and Warner Bros. near the merger close


A US court approved the settlement of the states' antitrust lawsuit over the **Paramount Skydance (PSKY)** and Warner Bros. Discovery merger. According to[IndieWire](https://www.indiewire.com/news/breaking-news/paramount-last-hurdle-merger-warner-bros-discovery-1235218714/) , the $111 billion deal is expected to close on 6 October.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


On Wednesday evening US time, Nasdaq 100 futures rose 0.26% and S&P 500 futures rose 0.24% after Micron's report, according to[FXEmpire](https://www.fxempire.com/forecasts/article/nasdaq-100-microns-ai-beat-gives-futures-a-bid-before-payrolls-1634133) .


## Macro Note 📝


South Korea's September exports hit a record $120.9 billion, with chip exports up 262.8% to $60.3 billion, according to[The Korea Times](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/20261001/koreas-sept-exports-hit-record-1209-bil-on-robust-chip-sales) . Oil held in the mid-$90-per-barrel range, according to[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-wednesday-september-30-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-080339262.html) .


## Conclusion


Micron's report and South Korea's record chip exports both point to strong AI memory demand. Tonight, the market tests whether US economic data supports that story.


With yields still high, the ISM and jobless claims readings could shift Fed rate expectations ahead of Friday's jobs report.
